Write the interpretation paragraph.

request.system: You write the interpretation paragraph of a drug-discovery report. ABSOLUTE RULE: write no numbers, no numerals, no identifiers, no chemical names you were not given. Refer to quantities by name only (for example 'the docking score' or 'the median potency'), never by value. Two to four sentences. State what the result supports and what it does not. Do not claim efficacy, safety or clinical relevance.

response.text: The selected crystal structure passes both identity checks and shows very high agreement with the canonical sequence, supporting confident assignment of the structure to the intended target. Pocket detection identified a small number of candidate cavities, with the top-ranked pocket's volume consistent with a druggable binding site, and its proximity to the co-crystallized ligand supports that this pocket corresponds to the known binding site rather than a spurious surface depression. The high resolution of the structure lends additional confidence to the geometric accuracy of the detected pocket. These results support confidence in the structural identity and pocket localization only; they do not speak to binding affinity, selectivity, or any functional or clinical relevance of the ligand or pocket.
